group_scores.rationale: Strong T1 fundamentals (DC revenue +110% y/y, Q4 guide $130bn with zero China) offset confirmed BIS five-country licence and worldwide D:5 data-centre end-use control, T2-only SEC inquiry report, verbal data-centre tax threat and rates-driven selloff. US-HQ exemption, Diffusion-rule rescission, BIS's ~100 licences/yr estimate and MOFCOM's conditional (unnamed) countermeasures limit the policy hit. Net roughly neutral vs world on 1-3m.
group_scores.falsifier: -1 on T1/T2 confirmation of formal SEC/DOJ action against Nvidia, concrete MOFCOM retaliation, disclosed material non-US-HQ SEA revenue, or hyperscaler capex cut. +1 on capex raises and clean probe closures.

group_scores.rationale: Mega-cap-led correction on 11/20 was rates/sentiment-driven; no index-level earnings downgrade; Nvidia guide supports index EPS; US-HQ exemption shields hyperscaler builds. Sector negatives not broad enough to tilt S&P vs world.
group_scores.falsifier: -1 if formal SEC action on Nvidia, a concrete data-centre-abroad tax, or a broad downgrade cycle. +1 on capex-led mega-cap rebound with clean probe outcomes.

group_scores.rationale: World index holds the same US AI mega-cap weight diluted; effect vs world neutral by construction. BIS spillover to MY/SG/TH hubs is small weight; China response so far rhetorical.
group_scores.falsifier: Negative if contagion into non-US tech (TSMC, Korea memory) or concrete Chinese retaliation broadens the selloff.

CEO resignation then reinstatement (8-Ks), continuing board probe, T2-only SEC accounting report, delayed 10-Q. Watch item; concentration flag to EVT04/FIT08.
Verbal Trump 'tremendous tax' threat; no mechanism, staff not briefed.
IFR amends presumptions for front-end fabs and packagers (quote verified); scope needs full-text read.
